standardColumnsEn.id: Primary key, BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT (Java Long); all references point here
standardColumnsEn.deleted: Logical delete flag; money and history facts are never deleted

tables.name: pay_channel_product
tables.purpose: 支付产品：渠道 × 接入模式 × 支付类型 × 支付方式。运营开关；实际能力以代码实现的接口为准，启动比对

columns.name: product_code
columns.meaning: 产品码（种子数据的自然键），如 NEWEBPAY_CREDIT、LINEPAY_ONLINE、PAYBY_POS_CARD
columns.meaningEn: Product code (natural key of seed data)

columns.name: access_mode
columns.meaning: MERCHANT_OWN / SERVICE_PROVIDER / PLATFORM_SUB：用谁的凭据调渠道

columns.name: pay_type
columns.meaning: ONLINE / OFFLINE / CARD：走哪类能力接口

columns.name: pay_method
columns.meaning: 统一支付方式码：CARD_ONLINE / APPLE_PAY / ATM / CVS / LINE_PAY / TAIWAN_PAY / WALLET / JSAPI / SCAN_CUSTOMER / STORE_QR / CARD_PRESENT …

columns.name: channel_method
columns.meaning: 渠道侧方式码：蓝新 CREDIT / VACC / CVS，微信 JSAPI，PayBy 产品码

columns.name: allowed_funds_paths
columns.meaning: 逗号分隔：DIRECT / AGGREGATED；TW 两家只允许 DIRECT

columns.name: refund_mode
columns.meaning: ONLINE 原路退 / OFFLINE 无原路退需线下 / UNSUPPORTED

columns.name: max_partial_refunds
columns.meaning: 单笔最多部分退款次数；0 = 未知 / 不限
columns.meaningEn: Max partial refunds per payment; 0 = unknown / unlimited

columns.name: two_phase
columns.meaning: 是否两段式（ATM / 超商取号后再缴费；LINE Pay 授权后 confirm）
columns.meaningEn: Two-phase flow (ATM / CVS code then payment; LINE Pay authorise then confirm)

tables.purposeEn: Payment product = channel × access mode × payment type × payment method. An ops switch; real capability is whatever the code implements, compared at startup.

tables.name: pay_channel_product_market
tables.purpose: 支付产品在哪些国家地区可用，及该地区的币种与金额范围。无行 = 该产品在该地区不可用

columns.name: amount_scale
columns.meaning: 出通道金额精度：TWD 在蓝新 / LINE Pay 为 0（整数元），AED 为 2；有余数即拒
columns.meaningEn: Decimal scale sent to the channel; a remainder is rejected, never rounded

tables.purposeEn: Countries / regions where a product is available, with currency and amount limits. No row = unavailable in that market.

tables.name: pay_onboarding
tables.purpose: 进件单：某门店向某渠道申请收款能力。资料与每次提交是版本；成功产出 pay_merchant

columns.name: onboarding_no
columns.meaning: 进件单号（对外：进件回调地址里使用）

columns.name: store_id
columns.meaning: 门店 mch_store.id（核心系统；关联核心系统一律用门店 id）
columns.meaningEn: Store (mch_store.id, core system); the core system is always referenced by store id

columns.name: parent_pay_merchant_id
columns.meaning: SERVICE_PROVIDER / PLATFORM_SUB 时挂在哪个平台级收款商户下（pay_merchant.id）

columns.name: legal_form
columns.meaning: 通道进件档位（小微 / 个体户 / 企业…），不是法律形态真源
columns.meaningEn: Channel onboarding tier (not the legal-form source of truth)

columns.name: status
columns.meaning: DRAFT / SUBMITTED / CHANNEL_REVIEW / NEED_SIGN / APPROVED / REJECTED / CANCELLED

columns.name: channel_apply_no
columns.meaning: 渠道侧申请单号（当前版本）

columns.name: sign_url
columns.meaning: NEED_SIGN 时渠道给的签约链接

columns.name: reject_reason
columns.meaning: 当前版本驳回原因，原样给商家看；历史原因在版本表
columns.meaningEn: Rejection reason, shown to the merchant as is

columns.name: pay_merchant_id
columns.meaning: APPROVED 后产出的收款商户 pay_merchant.id

columns.name: entity_name_snapshot
columns.meaning: 建单时门店所属主体名快照

columns.name: initiator_type
columns.meaning: BIZ 商家自助 / OPS 运营代办

columns.name: initiator_no
columns.meaning: 发起人（审计字段，与 created_by 同口径，不作关联）
columns.meaningEn: Initiated by (audit field, not a reference)

columns.name: inflight_key
columns.meaning: 在途唯一键：SUBMITTED / CHANNEL_REVIEW / NEED_SIGN 时 = store_id|pay_channel，否则 NULL；服务同事务维护（防 R06 重复进件）
columns.meaningEn: Uniqueness helper while in flight, otherwise NULL

tables.purposeEn: A store applying to a channel for collection capability. Materials and each submission are versioned; success produces a pay_merchant.

tables.name: pay_onboarding_version
tables.purpose: 进件提交版本：每次提交一行，外部单号每次唯一（修 R04）；驳回原因随版本保留（修 R23）

columns.name: out_request_no
columns.meaning: 提交给渠道的外部单号（out_request_no / out_biz_no），每版本唯一
columns.meaningEn: External request number sent to the channel, unique per submission

columns.name: materials_sha256
columns.meaning: 本版资料规范化摘要，防止提交后资料被改
columns.meaningEn: Canonical digest of this version's materials

columns.name: status
columns.meaning: DRAFT / SUBMITTED / CHANNEL_REVIEW / NEED_SIGN / APPROVED / REJECTED / SUPERSEDED

columns.name: reject_reason
columns.meaningEn: Rejection reason, shown to the merchant as is

tables.purposeEn: One row per submission; the external request number is unique per submission and the rejection reason is kept with its version.

tables.name: pay_onboarding_material
tables.purpose: 进件资料：一字段一行、按版本只增。敏感字段只存密文 id 与掩码；文件存对象存储，库里只存引用与哈希

columns.name: field_code
columns.meaning: 字段码：LEGAL_NAME / LICENSE_NO / ID_NUMBER / BANK_ACCOUNT / CONTACT_MOBILE / LICENSE_IMAGE …（字段字典按渠道维护）

columns.name: field_kind
columns.meaning: TEXT 普通 / SENSITIVE 敏感 / FILE 文件

columns.name: value_masked
columns.meaning: SENSITIVE / FILE：展示用掩码或文件名

columns.name: sec_secret_blob_id
columns.meaning: 仅 SENSITIVE：密文 sec_secret_blob.id（密钥模块，命名空间 PAY）；查看明文写 sec_access_log

columns.name: file_ref
columns.meaning: 仅 FILE：对象存储私有桶键

columns.name: channel_media_id
columns.meaning: 已上传渠道换得的媒体号（微信 media_id 等）
columns.meaningEn: Media ID returned after uploading to the channel

checks: field_kind <> 'SENSITIVE' OR (sec_secret_blob_id IS NOT NULL AND value_text IS NULL)
field_kind <> 'FILE' OR file_ref IS NOT NULL
tables.purposeEn: One field per row, append-only by version. Sensitive values are stored only as cipher references and masks; files live in object storage.

tables.name: pay_merchant
tables.purpose: 收款商户 = 渠道中的商户。一个主体（经其门店）对多个收款商户；每个只属于一个渠道、一个市场、一种接入模式、一种资金路径。取代 mch_payment_merchant

columns.name: pay_merchant_no
columns.meaning: 收款商户号（对外：回调地址、结算单）。**迁移时沿用 mch_payment_merchant.pay_merchant_no 原值**

columns.name: owner_type
columns.meaning: STORE 商家门店开的 / PLATFORM 平台自己的（服务商号、平台账户、CN 平台直连号）

columns.name: store_id
columns.meaning: 开户门店 mch_store.id；owner_type=PLATFORM 时为 NULL。其他门店共用经 pay_merchant_binding
columns.meaningEn: Store (mch_store.id, core system); the core system is always referenced by store id

columns.name: funds_path
columns.meaning: DIRECT 结算到商户自己的账户（含微信二级商户）/ AGGREGATED 结算到平台账户

columns.name: channel_merchant_id
columns.meaning: 渠道商户号：蓝新 MerchantID / LINE Pay ChannelId / PayBy Partner-Id / 微信 mchid（SP 模式为服务商号）

columns.name: sub_merchant_id
columns.meaning: 子商户号：微信 sub_mchid / 支付宝 smid / PayBy 子商户标识；无则空串（参与唯一键）
columns.meaningEn: Sub-merchant ID inside the channel; empty string if none

columns.name: parent_pay_merchant_id
columns.meaning: SERVICE_PROVIDER / PLATFORM_SUB 时引用平台级收款商户 pay_merchant.id（取其密钥）

columns.name: pay_onboarding_id
columns.meaning: 产出它的进件单 pay_onboarding.id；存量迁移行可空

columns.name: sec_key_id
columns.meaning: 调用渠道用的密钥 sec_key.id（MERCHANT_OWN 必填；SP / 平台子商户取父商户的）

columns.name: sec_key_version
columns.meaning: 当前密钥版本号；交易冻结此值
columns.meaningEn: Key version number frozen for this record

columns.name: legal_form
columns.meaningEn: Channel onboarding tier (not the legal-form source of truth)

columns.name: invoice_capable
columns.meaning: 能否开票（下单前必须披露）
columns.meaningEn: Can issue invoices (must be disclosed before ordering)

columns.name: settle_account_masked
columns.meaning: 结算账户掩码；明文只在渠道

columns.name: settle_cycle
columns.meaning: 渠道结算周期：T1 / T2 / WEEKLY …

columns.name: split_reversible
columns.meaning: 分账可回退授权；NULL = 未知按未授权
columns.meaningEn: Split reversal authorised; NULL = unknown, treated as not authorised

columns.name: priority
columns.meaning: 同一支付方式多条可用路由时的选择顺序，小者优先

columns.name: entity_name_snapshot
columns.meaning: 开户时主体名快照（PLATFORM 为空）

checks: owner_type = 'PLATFORM' OR store_id IS NOT NULL
access_mode <> 'MERCHANT_OWN' OR sec_key_id IS NOT NULL OR status IN ('ONBOARDING','CLOSED')
access_mode = 'MERCHANT_OWN' OR parent_pay_merchant_id IS NOT NULL
notes: 「这家门店这个渠道收到哪个商户」不在本表约束，由 pay_merchant_binding 的 active_key 唯一索引保证
tables.purposeEn: A merchant account inside a channel, opened by a store (or owned by the platform). Each belongs to exactly one channel, market, access mode and funds path. Replaces mch_payment_merchant.

tables.name: pay_merchant_binding
tables.purpose: 收款路由绑定：门店 × 渠道同一时刻一条 ACTIVE。取代 mch_store.pay_merchant_no 与旧表的 store_no 维度（修 R02/R03/R26）

columns.name: store_id
columns.meaning: 门店 mch_store.id（核心系统；关联核心系统一律用门店 id）
columns.meaningEn: Store (mch_store.id, core system); the core system is always referenced by store id

columns.name: active_key
columns.meaning: ACTIVE 时 = store_id|pay_channel，否则 NULL；服务同事务维护
columns.meaningEn: Uniqueness helper: composite key while ACTIVE, otherwise NULL; maintained by the service in the same transaction

notes: 只按门店绑定，**没有主体级默认号**：一个收款商户给多家店用，就给每家店各建一条绑定。解析无绑定即不可收款，不做「取第一个可用号」兜底（R01 根因）
绑定时校验：收款商户 ACTIVE、市场与门店一致、开户门店与本门店同属一个主体（经核心系统 Port 判断）
tables.purposeEn: Store × channel routing binding; at most one ACTIVE per store per channel. No entity-level default.

tables.name: pay_merchant_product
tables.purpose: 收款商户开通的支付产品。只能由渠道回执或运营确认写入，禁止按主体类型推断

columns.name: quota_limit_minor
columns.meaning: 累计收款额度；0 = 未设置（不是额度为零）
columns.meaningEn: Cumulative collection quota; 0 = not set (not zero quota)

columns.name: quota_used_minor
columns.meaning: 本周期已用；累加必须检查乐观锁返回值（修 R24）
columns.meaningEn: Used in current period; updates must check the optimistic lock result

tables.purposeEn: Products a payment merchant has opened; written only from channel receipts or ops confirmation, never inferred.

tables.name: pay_merchant_status_log
tables.purpose: 收款商户状态变更留痕（启用、切换资金路径、暂停、关闭）
tables.purposeEn: Audit trail of payment merchant status changes (activation, funds path switch, suspension, closing).

tables.name: pay_order
tables.purpose: 支付订单：调用方要收的一笔钱，独立于业务订单。一张支付单可有多次通道尝试（stl_payment）

columns.name: pay_order_no
columns.meaning: 支付单号（对外：接口响应、收银台、对账）

columns.name: pay_app_id
columns.meaning: 调用方 pay_app.id（内部系统也注册 app，如 MALL / FOOD）

columns.name: out_order_no
columns.meaning: 调用方订单号；与 pay_app_id 联合唯一（幂等）
columns.meaningEn: Caller's order number; unique with app_id (idempotency)

columns.name: biz_no
columns.meaning: 调用方业务单号（字符串，由调用方给出，不作关联）

columns.name: store_id
columns.meaning: 门店 mch_store.id（核心系统；关联核心系统一律用门店 id）
columns.meaningEn: Store (mch_store.id, core system); the core system is always referenced by store id

columns.name: amount_minor
columns.meaning: 应付金额（最小单位），建单后不改

columns.name: reserved_refund_minor
columns.meaning: 退款复核 / 在途占用
columns.meaningEn: Reserved by refunds under review / in flight

columns.name: subject
columns.meaning: 商品标题（展示在通道收银台）
columns.meaningEn: Subject shown on the channel cashier

columns.name: pay_type
columns.meaning: 选定方式后写入：ONLINE / OFFLINE / CARD

columns.name: pay_method
columns.meaning: 选定的统一支付方式码

columns.name: pay_merchant_id
columns.meaning: **路由快照**：收款商户 pay_merchant.id（选定方式时冻结，此后不改）

columns.name: sub_merchant_id
columns.meaning: 路由快照：渠道子商户号（渠道侧字符串）
columns.meaningEn: Sub-merchant ID inside the channel; empty string if none

columns.name: sec_key_version
columns.meaningEn: Key version number frozen for this record

columns.name: status
columns.meaning: CREATED / AWAITING_PAYMENT / AUTHORIZED / AWAITING_CONFIRM / SUCCEEDED / PARTIALLY_REFUNDED / REFUNDED / CLOSED / FAILED

columns.name: notify_url
columns.meaning: 第三方 webhook 覆盖地址（白名单内）

columns.name: source_type
columns.meaning: PARTNER / INTERNAL / TERMINAL / BIZ / OPS / CHECKOUT

columns.name: source_id
columns.meaning: 来源 id：PARTNER / INTERNAL → pay_app.id；TERMINAL → pay_terminal.id；CHECKOUT → pay_qr_code.id 或 pay_checkout_session.id；BIZ / OPS → 账号 id

columns.name: operator_no
columns.meaning: 收银员 / 商家操作员（审计字段）

columns.name: request_sha256
columns.meaning: 建单请求规范化摘要：同幂等键不同内容 → 拒绝
columns.meaningEn: Canonical request digest: same idempotency key with different content is rejected

checks: paid_minor >= 0 AND refunded_minor >= 0 AND reserved_refund_minor >= 0
refunded_minor + reserved_refund_minor <= paid_minor
tables.purposeEn: An amount a caller wants to collect, independent of the business order. One payment order can have several channel attempts (stl_payment).

tables.name: pay_refund
tables.purpose: 退款单：商家侧发起的一次退款申请，含复核。执行由 RefundExecutionService 落 stl_payment(direction=REFUND)

columns.name: pay_order_id
columns.meaning: 原支付单 pay_order.id（路由一律取原单快照；本表无路由列）

columns.name: biz_refund_no
columns.meaning: 业务售后单号（字符串，取代合成的 AS-{subOrderNo}，R21）

columns.name: store_id
columns.meaning: 门店 mch_store.id（核心系统；关联核心系统一律用门店 id）
columns.meaningEn: Store (mch_store.id, core system); the core system is always referenced by store id

columns.name: refund_mode
columns.meaning: ONLINE 原路 / OFFLINE 线下（商家自退并上传凭证）

columns.name: status
columns.meaning: REQUESTED / PENDING_REVIEW / PENDING_SECOND_REVIEW / APPROVED / DISPATCHED / SUCCEEDED / FAILED / REJECTED / OFFLINE_PENDING_PROOF

columns.name: authorized_by
columns.meaning: 店长授权人（终端发起时，审计字段）

columns.name: pay_refund_review_rule_id
columns.meaning: 命中的复核规则版本 pay_refund_review_rule.id（一行即一个版本）

columns.name: hit_reasons
columns.meaning: 命中原因：SINGLE_AMOUNT / DAILY_AMOUNT / RATIO / AFTER_DAYS / ALWAYS / NO_ACTIVE_RULE

columns.name: stl_payment_id
columns.meaning: 执行时生成的通道交易 stl_payment.id

columns.name: offline_proof_ref
columns.meaning: 线下退款凭证文件引用

columns.name: failed_reason
columns.meaning: 失败原因（原样告知商家）
columns.meaningEn: Failure reason (shown to the merchant as is)

checks: amount_minor > 0
tables.purposeEn: A refund requested by the merchant side, including review. Execution writes stl_payment(direction=REFUND).

tables.name: pay_refund_review_rule
tables.purpose: 退款复核规则（一行一个版本）：命中任一门槛 → 平台两人复核。某市场无 ACTIVE 规则 = 该市场全部复核

columns.name: rule_code
columns.meaning: 规则码：同一规则的各版本共用
columns.meaningEn: Rule code shared by all versions of a rule

columns.name: active_key
columns.meaning: ACTIVE 时 = rule_code：一条规则同一时刻一个生效版本
columns.meaningEn: Uniqueness helper: composite key while ACTIVE, otherwise NULL; maintained by the service in the same transaction

columns.name: store_id
columns.meaning: 门店 mch_store.id；NULL = 全市场（门店级更具体者优先）
columns.meaningEn: Store (mch_store.id, core system); the core system is always referenced by store id

columns.name: daily_amount_minor
columns.meaning: 门店当日（市场时区）累计 + 本笔 ≥ 此值
columns.meaningEn: Merchant's daily total incl. this refund ≥ value

columns.name: refund_ratio_bp
columns.meaning: 本笔占原单比例 ≥ 此值（万分比）

columns.name: after_days
columns.meaning: 原单支付超过 N 天
columns.meaningEn: Original payment older than N days

columns.name: activated_by
columns.meaning: 生效确认人，必须 ≠ 起草人

checks: status <> 'ACTIVE' OR always_review = 1 OR single_amount_minor IS NOT NULL OR daily_amount_minor IS NOT NULL OR refund_ratio_bp IS NOT NULL OR after_days IS NOT NULL
activated_by IS NULL OR activated_by <> drafted_by
tables.purposeEn: One row per rule version; hitting any threshold requires two-person platform review. A market without an ACTIVE rule reviews every refund.

tables.name: pay_approval
tables.purpose: 两人复核单（通用）：退款、出款、密钥启用、资金路径切换、收款商户启用、复核规则生效

columns.name: subject_type
columns.meaning: REFUND / PAYOUT / KEY_ENABLE / FUNDS_PATH_SWITCH / MERCHANT_ACTIVATE / REVIEW_RULE_ACTIVATE

columns.name: subject_id
columns.meaning: 对象 id（按 subject_type：pay_refund / stl_payout / sec_key_version / pay_merchant / pay_refund_review_rule）

columns.name: subject_sha256
columns.meaning: 提交复核时对象内容摘要；复核时对象被改动即失效
columns.meaningEn: Digest of the subject when submitted; any later change invalidates the approval

columns.name: status
columns.meaning: PENDING_FIRST / PENDING_SECOND / APPROVED / REJECTED / CANCELLED / EXPIRED

columns.name: open_key
columns.meaning: 进行中时 = subject_type|subject_id：一个对象同时只有一张进行中复核单
columns.meaningEn: Uniqueness helper while open, otherwise NULL

columns.name: reject_reason
columns.meaningEn: Rejection reason, shown to the merchant as is

checks: first_reviewer IS NULL OR first_reviewer <> requested_by
second_reviewer IS NULL OR (second_reviewer <> requested_by AND second_reviewer <> first_reviewer)
tables.purposeEn: Generic two-person review for refunds, payouts, key enablement, funds path switch and rule activation.

tables.name: pay_exception
tables.purpose: 支付异常：关单后支付、金额不符、重复支付等需要处置的事实（修 R18：关单后成功不再静默改成功）
tables.purposeEn: Facts that need handling: payment after close, amount mismatch, duplicate payment, currency mismatch.

tables.name: pay_checkout_session
tables.purpose: 收银会话：扫码 H5 / 托管收银台的一次性令牌，绑定一张支付单

columns.name: token_sha256
columns.meaning: 令牌哈希；明文只在链接里
columns.meaningEn: Token hash; plaintext only in the link

tables.purposeEn: One-time token for the H5 / hosted checkout, bound to one payment order.

tables.name: pay_qr_code
tables.purpose: 静态码：门店 / 桌台码，顾客输金额建单。码值随机不可枚举

columns.name: qr_code
columns.meaning: 码值（随机，出现在 URL 里）

columns.name: store_id
columns.meaning: 门店 mch_store.id（核心系统；关联核心系统一律用门店 id）
columns.meaningEn: Store (mch_store.id, core system); the core system is always referenced by store id

tables.purposeEn: Store / table QR code where the customer enters the amount. Codes are random and not enumerable.

tables.name: pay_ledger_voucher
tables.purpose: 记账凭证：一次资金事件一张，下挂借贷平衡的分录。只增不改，更正只能追加冲正凭证

columns.name: voucher_no
columns.meaning: 凭证号（给财务看的编号）

columns.name: voucher_type
columns.meaning: PAY_SUCCEEDED / REFUND_SUCCEEDED / CHANNEL_FEE / PLATFORM_FEE / SETTLEMENT / PAYOUT / FEE_OFFSET / ADJUST / REVERSAL

columns.name: ref_type
columns.meaning: PAY_ORDER / PAY_REFUND / STL_BILL / STL_PAYOUT / FEE_RECEIVABLE / MANUAL

columns.name: ref_id
columns.meaning: 引用对象 id（按 ref_type）；MANUAL 为空
columns.meaningEn: Referenced object id, resolved by ref_type

columns.name: idem_key
columns.meaning: 幂等键：voucher_type|ref_type|ref_id[|序号]，同一事件只记一次
columns.meaningEn: Idempotency key: one money event is booked once

columns.name: total_minor
columns.meaning: 借方合计 = 贷方合计

columns.name: biz_date
columns.meaning: 业务日（按市场时区切日）

columns.meaning: 附加认证数据（id + namespace + owner_type + owner_id + env）的摘要：密文被挪到别的行即解密失败
columns.meaningEn: Digest of additional authenticated data (id + namespace + owner_type + owner_id + env); moving ciphertext to another row breaks decryption

columns.name: rewrapped_at
columns.meaning: 最近一次主密钥轮换重新包裹的时间
columns.meaningEn: Last re-wrapped by master key rotation

notes: 只有密钥模块的 SecretVault（进程内库）读写；任何接口、日志、导出都不出现 cipher_text
tables.purposeEn: Envelope-encrypted ciphertext of key material and sensitive fields of any domain. Data keys are wrapped by a master key that never touches the database.

tables.name: sec_key_policy
tables.purpose: 密钥策略：按命名空间、归属类型与环境规定有效期、到期提醒、轮换重叠期、双人控制

columns.name: namespace
columns.meaningEn: Namespace: one set of master keys per domain; a process can only decrypt its own

columns.name: owner_type
columns.meaning: PAY_MERCHANT / CHANNEL_PLATFORM / PARTNER_APP / INTERNAL_APP / TERMINAL / PROVIDER …

columns.name: max_age_days
columns.meaning: 版本最长使用天数；0 = 不强制（以证书有效期为准）
columns.meaningEn: Maximum days a version may be used; 0 = not enforced

columns.name: overlap_days
columns.meaning: 轮换重叠期：新版本启用后旧版本仍可用的天数
columns.meaningEn: Rotation overlap: days the old version stays usable

columns.name: dual_control
columns.meaning: 启用 / 吊销是否需要两人

columns.name: verify_before_enable
columns.meaning: 启用前是否必须测试调用通过
columns.meaningEn: A test call must pass before enabling

columns.name: reveal_on_issue_only
columns.meaning: 平台生成的密钥明文是否只在发放时展示一次
columns.meaningEn: Generated key plaintext is shown only once at issue

tables.purposeEn: Lifetime, expiry warning, rotation overlap and dual control by namespace, owner type and environment.

tables.name: sec_key
tables.purpose: 密钥：调用外部 API 与被外部调用的每一把密钥。支付命名空间下包括：我方调渠道、渠道平台公钥、第三方与内部系统调我方、刷卡机。材料在版本表

columns.name: namespace
columns.meaningEn: Namespace: one set of master keys per domain; a process can only decrypt its own

columns.name: owner_type
columns.meaning: PAY_MERCHANT 收款商户调渠道 / CHANNEL_PLATFORM 渠道平台公钥与证书 / PARTNER_APP 第三方接入方 / INTERNAL_APP 内部系统 / TERMINAL 刷卡机 / PROVIDER 其他域的外部服务商

columns.name: owner_id
columns.meaning: 归属对象 id：pay_merchant.id / pay_app.id / pay_terminal.id …
columns.meaningEn: Owner object id, resolved by owner_type

columns.name: counterparty
columns.meaning: 对端系统码：NEWEBPAY / LINEPAY / PAYBY / WECHAT / ALIPAY / KUAIDI100 …

columns.name: direction
columns.meaning: OUTBOUND 我方调外部时使用 / INBOUND 外部调我方时我方验证 / COUNTERPARTY_VERIFY 验对端响应与回调

columns.name: key_usage
columns.meaning: SIGN 签名 / VERIFY 验签 / HMAC / ENCRYPT 加解密 / MTLS 双向证书
columns.meaningEn: Key usage (column not named usage: USAGE is a MariaDB reserved word)

columns.name: material_type
columns.meaning: SYMMETRIC_SECRET / PRIVATE_KEY / PUBLIC_KEY / CERTIFICATE / COMPOSITE（蓝新 HashKey + HashIV）

columns.name: env
columns.meaning: SANDBOX / PRODUCTION：生产密钥永不进入沙箱

columns.name: current_version
columns.meaning: 当前 ACTIVE 版本号；0 = 尚无

columns.name: sec_key_policy_id
columns.meaning: 适用策略 sec_key_policy.id；空 = 按 namespace + owner_type + env 取默认

columns.name: expires_at
columns.meaning: 当前版本到期时间（证书有效期或策略最长使用期，取早者）

columns.name: use_count
columns.meaning: 累计使用次数（异步累加，近似值）

notes: 同一归属、同一用途、同一环境只有一把密钥；轮换是在它下面加版本，而不是新建密钥
webhook 推送签名复用接入方的 INBOUND HMAC 密钥（对称），不单独建
tables.purposeEn: Every key for calling external APIs or being called by them. In the PAY namespace: our channel calls, channel platform keys, partner / internal apps, terminals. Material lives in versions.

tables.name: sec_key_version
tables.purpose: 密钥版本：一把密钥的每一份材料。私密材料只存密文 id，公钥与证书可明文存放

columns.name: version_index
columns.meaning: 版本号，从 1 起（交易冻结的是这个号）

columns.name: status
columns.meaning: DRAFT 已录入 / VERIFIED 测试通过 / ACTIVE 当前 / ROTATING 重叠期仍可用 / RETIRED 仅验旧签与在途单 / REVOKED 立即失效

columns.name: active_key
columns.meaning: ACTIVE 时 = sec_key_id：一把密钥同一时刻一个 ACTIVE 版本
columns.meaningEn: Uniqueness helper: composite key while ACTIVE, otherwise NULL; maintained by the service in the same transaction

columns.name: sec_secret_blob_id
columns.meaning: 私密材料的密文 sec_secret_blob.id（对称密钥、私钥）

columns.name: public_material
columns.meaning: 公钥或证书 PEM（可公开，不加密）
columns.meaningEn: Public key or certificate PEM (public, not encrypted)

columns.name: fingerprint
columns.meaning: 指纹：公钥 / 证书为 SHA-256，对称密钥为 HMAC 派生前缀；唯一可回显的信息
columns.meaningEn: Fingerprint — the only key information ever shown

columns.name: external_key_id
columns.meaning: 外部密钥标识：微信平台证书序列号、PayBy 公钥 ID、接入方 key id
columns.meaningEn: External key identifier (WeChat platform cert serial, PayBy key ID, app key ID)

columns.name: source
columns.meaning: GENERATED 平台生成 / UPLOADED 人工录入 / FETCHED 从对端下载（微信平台证书）

columns.name: valid_to
columns.meaning: 生效止（证书 notAfter / 策略最长使用期）
columns.meaningEn: Valid to (certificate notAfter / policy max age)

columns.name: verify_evidence
columns.meaning: 测试调用证据：调用方模块写入的记录引用，如 PAY:pay_channel_call_log:123（不作关联）
columns.meaningEn: Test-call evidence written by the calling module (not a reference)

columns.name: enabled_by
columns.meaning: 启用人，必须 ≠ 录入人
columns.meaningEn: Enabled by; must differ from the person who entered it

columns.name: overlap_until
columns.meaning: 轮换后旧版本仍可用至

columns.name: revoke_reason
columns.meaning: 吊销原因（泄露、离职、商户解约…）
columns.meaningEn: Revocation reason (leak, staff exit, merchant termination…)

checks: sec_secret_blob_id IS NOT NULL OR public_material IS NOT NULL
enabled_by IS NULL OR enabled_by <> entered_by
notes: 交易冻结的是 (sec_key_id, version_index)：退款、查单、验旧回调用冻结版本，RETIRED 也可用，REVOKED 不可用
tables.purposeEn: Each piece of material of a key. Secret material is stored only as a ciphertext id; public keys and certificates may be stored in clear.

tables.name: sec_key_event
tables.purpose: 密钥生命周期事件：创建、录入、测试、启用、轮换、退役、吊销、到期提醒、重新包裹。只增不改

columns.name: sec_key_version_id
columns.meaning: 版本 sec_key_version.id（密钥级事件为空）

columns.name: event_type
columns.meaning: CREATED / MATERIAL_ADDED / VERIFIED / VERIFY_FAILED / ENABLED / ROTATION_STARTED / RETIRED / REVOKED / SUSPENDED / RESUMED / EXPIRING_SOON / EXPIRED / REWRAPPED

columns.name: operator_type
columns.meaning: OPS 运营 / BIZ 商家 / SYSTEM 系统任务

columns.name: approval_ref
columns.meaning: 两人复核证据：调用方模块的复核单引用，如 PAY:pay_approval:88（不作关联）
columns.meaningEn: Approval evidence from the calling module (not a reference)

tables.purposeEn: Lifecycle events: created, material added, verified, enabled, rotated, retired, revoked, expiry warnings, re-wrapped. Append-only.

tables.name: sec_access_log
tables.purpose: 明文接触记录：任何人看到明文（发放时展示、查看敏感字段、查看报文原文、应急调阅）逐次记录。只增不改

columns.name: access_type
columns.meaning: REVEAL_ON_ISSUE 发放时展示 / SENSITIVE_FIELD_VIEW / RAW_PAYLOAD_VIEW / BREAK_GLASS 应急调阅

columns.name: namespace
columns.meaningEn: Namespace: one set of master keys per domain; a process can only decrypt its own

columns.name: accessor_role
columns.meaning: 查看时的岗位 / 权限码
columns.meaningEn: Role / permission code at access time

columns.name: approval_ref
columns.meaning: BREAK_GLASS 必须有复核单引用
columns.meaningEn: Approval evidence from the calling module (not a reference)

checks: sec_key_id IS NOT NULL OR sec_secret_blob_id IS NOT NULL OR target_id IS NOT NULL
access_type <> 'BREAK_GLASS' OR approval_ref IS NOT NULL
notes: 服务进程的常规解密不逐次记（量太大），由 sec_key.use_count / last_used_at 与监控覆盖；人接触明文一律逐次记
